name: SOC Detection Lab Coverage
description: Detection coverage from MITRE ATT&CK SOC Detection Lab. Custom Elastic SIEM rules validated with Atomic Red Team on Windows 11.

techniques.comment: Rule: Encoded PowerShell Execution | Validated with Atomic T1059.001 Test 1 | Mimikatz execution captured via Event ID 4104 and Sysmon Event ID 1
Rule: Registry Run Key Persistence | Validated with Atomic T1547.001 Test 1 | Sysmon Event ID 13, HKU SID path format confirmed and rule updated to match
Rule: Windows Defender Disabled via PowerShell | Validated with Atomic T1562.001 | Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring detected

Rule: LSASS Memory Dump via ProcDump | Validated with Atomic T1003.001 Test 1 | Three-hop chain confirmed: powershell.exe -> cmd.exe -> procdump.exe -> procdump64.exe | Rule uses RLIKE command-line matching, launcher-agnostic

Rule: System Information Discovery | Validated with Atomic T1082 Test 1 | Covers systeminfo.exe, hostname.exe, cmd.exe chaining, wmic os get | S-1-5-18 exclusion removed after testing revealed it blocked cmd.exe and reg.exe detection
Rule: Query Registry | Validated via reg.exe query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Disk\Enum captured during T1082 test | Scoped to sensitive registry paths

Partial coverage | Event IDs 4720 and 4732 captured | EQL sequence rule written but S-1-5-32-544 (Administrators group) not confirmed in test — test only added to Users group (S-1-5-32-545) | Detection strategy reference: DET0447, DET0583
